text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature 38.3°C (100.9°F), Heart Rate 120/min, Respiratory Rate 30/min. General Examination: Patient appears pale and fatigued; cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy detected. Abdominal Examination: Liver palpable 3 cm below the right costal margin; Spleen palpable 2 cm below the left costal margin; abdomen is soft and nontender. Complete Blood Count: Hemoglobin 10.1 g/dL, Leukocyte Count 63,000/mm3 (elevated), Platelet Count 27,000/mm3 (decreased). Bone Marrow Aspirate Findings: Predominantly immature cells positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT. Note: Peripheral Blood Smear and Bone Marrow Biopsy images were not included in the available data.

speaker: Doctor
text: The bone marrow findings of immature cells positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT, combined with her fever, bruising, and severe leg pain, strongly indicate Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (B-cell)
